checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: M1 storage core (atomic writes, sqlite catalog, hash-verified ingest); M2 HTTP API (token auth, upload, has, sync-state, status); M3 gallery UI + optional Pillow thumbnails; M4 Shortcut setup page + backup command; M5 README, CLI, end-to-end run

impact_assessment.why: User wants an iPhone to copy photos to their PC over home Wi-Fi with no app, and to delete from the phone only what the PC verifiably holds
impact_assessment.benefits: No iPhone app; originals kept; deletion gated on a server-side hash re-check; stdlib-only core
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Shortcuts may hash/send different bytes than expected; dependency: Pillow/pillow-heif optional; concurrency: parallel uploads of same file; state: sqlite catalog and partial uploads on power loss
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reject any hash mismatch so nothing unverified is deletable; Pillow imported only in thumbnail adapter; sqlite transactions with unique sha256; uploads stream to .incoming temp, fsync, then os.replace

checkpoints.description: [5/5] M1-M5 built: hash-verified store, Shortcut API, gallery, setup guide, backup, README, ADR-001; 45 tests and 4/4 gates pass; live server smoke run passed; checklists: passed; not committed (host requires an explicit commit request)
